transactionName: HIPAA Health Care Claim: Professional X222A1-837
description: Enriched schema for the Health Care Claim Transaction Set (837). This schema includes structural definitions, element-level constraints, and codified complex validation rules derived from the implementation guide.

rules.description: The Originator Application Transaction Identifier (BHT03) is limited to 30 characters.
The Total Claim Charge Amount (CLM02) must balance to the sum of all service line charge amounts (SV102).
If the claim is related to an Auto (AA) or Other (OA) Accident, the Accident Date (DTP with qualifier 439) is required.
The Pay-To Plan Name Loop (2010AC) may only be used when BHT06 (Claim or Encounter Identifier) is '31' (Subrogation Demand).

2010AA.NM1.name: Billing Provider Name
2010AA.NM1.description: Identifies the provider to be paid for the services rendered.

2010BB.NM1.name: Payer Name
2010BB.NM1.description: Identifies the destination payer for the claim.

ISA.name: Interchange Control Header
ISA.description: To start and identify an interchange of zero or more functional groups and interchange-related control segments.

GS.name: Functional Group Header
GS.description: To indicate the beginning of a functional group and to provide control information.

ST.name: Transaction Set Header
ST.description: To indicate the start of a transaction set and to assign a control number.

elements.name: Transaction Set Control Number
elements.description: Identifying control number that must be unique within the transaction set functional group. The value in ST02 must be identical to the value in SE02.

elements.name: Implementation Guide Version Name
elements.description: This field contains the same value as GS08. This element must be populated with the guide identifier from Section 1.2.

BHT.name: Beginning of Hierarchical Transaction
BHT.description: To define the business hierarchical structure of the transaction set and identify the business application purpose.

elements.name: Transaction Set Purpose Code
elements.description: Conveys the electronic transmission status of the 837 batch.

elements.name: Originator Application Transaction Identifier
elements.description: A number assigned by the originator to identify this transaction, often a batch control number.

NM1.name: Name
NM1.description: To supply the full name of an individual or organizational entity. This is the base definition.

elements.name: Entity Identifier Code
elements.description: Code identifying an organizational entity, a physical location, property or an individual.

elements.name: Entity Type Qualifier
elements.description: Code qualifying the type of entity.

elements.name: Identification Code Qualifier
elements.description: Code designating the system/method of code structure used for Identification Code (NM109).

PER.name: Administrative Communications Contact
PER.description: To identify a person or office to whom administrative communications should be directed.

CLM.name: Claim Information
CLM.description: To specify basic data about the claim.

elements.name: Patient Control Number
elements.description: The number that the submitter transmits in this position is echoed back to the submitter in the 835 and other transactions.

elements.name: Auto Accident State or Province Code

SE.name: Transaction Set Trailer
SE.description: To indicate the end of the transaction set and provide the count of the transmitted segments.

elements.name: Transaction Segment Count
elements.description: Total number of segments included in a transaction set including ST and SE segments.

elements.name: Transaction Set Control Number
elements.description: Must be identical to the value in ST02.

GE.name: Functional Group Trailer
GE.description: To indicate the end of a functional group and to provide control information.

IEA.name: Interchange Control Trailer
IEA.description: To define the end of an interchange of zero or more functional groups and interchange-related control segments.
